evidence: preview/evidence/janus_head_sheet_source_frame.jpg (8 azimuths around the head, faces at az 0 and az 180)
findings.severity: blocker for art acceptance of the raw Tripo result (repaired locally, see repair)
findings.what: Tripo task 330872a3 produced a two-faced (Janus) head: a full face at source -Y (tripo_part_12, from the front concept) and a second full face with a real nose/chin profile at source +Y (inside tripo_part_0); the wings and the crest were fitted to the MIRRORED side concept (swept toward source -Y). Cause: the side concept (drawn over ortho_left, face looking left) went into the Studio slot RIGHT (tripo-run.json slot_consistency warned).

findings.severity: major (found by verification of revision 1, fixed in revision 2)
findings.what: The dropped face tripo_part_12 sat inside a feathered hood of the torso part tripo_part_1 (neck column behind the head up to z 0.534 source). Without the face the hood is hollow: a bald dome behind the crest from the game camera and an open cavity from behind. Trimmed and capped (repair.trim, repair.caps, repair.patches).

The Tripo parts are one surface cut into parts; the per-part decimation opened sub-millimetre cracks along the shared cuts, visible with one-sided materials as 1-3 px background pinholes in game frames. Stitching (lowpoly.stitch) closes most of them; 50 px over 36 frames remain (see revision.verified_defects_fixed V1-NECK-SEE-THROUGH).

Tripo gave both ankles a gold band (the concept has one, on the left leg). The right band (tripo_part_11, a separate part) is kept: it bridges a 2.2 cm source gap between the right shin and tarsus; dropping it opened the leg.
The thighs are asymmetric: the left bulges forward (source y to -0.133), the right backward (to +0.072); knees are placed inside each thigh's mass.

Tripo PBR left the gold bands non-metallic (0 texels with metallic > 0.5); a colour rule (textures.metal_rule) sets metallic 1 / roughness 0.35 on the gold texels of the two band-carrying parts (proposal).

repair: 180 deg turn of the whole high-poly about Z: the side-consistent face (tripo_part_0) becomes the front, wings sweep back as in the side concept
trim of tripo_part_1: the hollow hood / neck column that framed the dropped face (15 829 high-poly faces above z 0.455 behind the head)
cap_100: closed domed cap over the torso's neck opening (874 game triangles, dark feather tone with a soft procedural scallop baked into BC and N)
patch_101: the head's own back feathers (tripo_part_0, Tripo UVs and textures) copied 4.5 cm back and down over the cap's upper half, with a reversed backing sheet 2 mm behind it (799 game triangles)
recolour of the torso's skin-coloured V at the back of the neck to the dark feather tone (bake.recolor, now two boxes: the V and its light tip below the cap)
all are proposals, recorded in the profile (repair, bake.recolor); the clean fix is a Tripo regeneration with the side concept in the LEFT slot (paid, orchestrator decision)

visual_assessment_vs_concept.front: silhouette, crest, pointed ears and palette follow the concept closely; the face is the strongest element; the crest is again the top of the figure (revision 1 showed the tan hood as a bald dome behind it); up close at the game pitch a thin dark edge of the nape cap/patch shows between two crest spikes; the neutral preview light flattens the wings compared with the concept's studio light; two gold bands instead of one; the parametric instance base instead of the concept's gold cylinder (deliberate)
visual_assessment_vs_concept.side: after the repair turn the side silhouette matches the concept: face profile left, crest swept back, wings swept back and raised, band on the near (left) leg
visual_assessment_vs_concept.back: the crest now continues into the collar through the copied back-of-head feathers, close to the back concept's dark nape; below them the cap reads as a smooth dark area inside the collar ruff (about 2 x 3 cm at the final scale), with the recoloured V under it - darker and flatter than the concept's feathers up close, a dark nape at game distance; no cavity, no light gap
visual_assessment_vs_concept.closeups: bake fidelity against the Tripo high-poly is high on face, talons, bands and wing feathers; faceted jawline and some crest spikes up close (face region 1.2k triangles); thin light slivers at a few feather edges
visual_assessment_vs_concept.k2: at K2 (7.5 m, FOV 35, pitch -55) the figure projects to 262 x 146 px and the face region to 36 x 27 px (k2-projection.json). From the front the dome above the crest is gone (before_after_k2_front). From behind (4.8 m, H2 = LEFT figure, crop_k2close_back_h2_left_prev_right): crest, dark nape and collar read as one dark feather mass, wings layered and lighter than the previous candidate's; a small light spot of the torso shows between the legs; the previous candidate reads flatter and darker. The three instances stay distinguishable without colour in all six K1/K2 frames
visual_assessment_vs_concept.vs_medusa_reference: the reference is a painted collectible with strong value contrast and specular breakup; H2 Harpy reaches its sculpt density in the high-poly and keeps most of it in the bake, but the material response is flatter (Tripo roughness ~0.77 almost everywhere, no specular variation in the feathers) and the colours lighter; the repaired nape is smoother than the rest of the plumage

falls_short: the neck cap is a smooth dark area inside the collar (the patch covers its upper half); not sculpted feathers

1-3 px see-through pinholes remain at every azimuth (50 px over 36 game frames, worst 6 px per frame): the verifier's strict gate (0 px behind the figure) is not met; no opening (component >= 4 px) remains
faceted jaw and crest spikes in extreme close-ups
head turn 35 deg opens a 3.0 cm gap between head and collar (limit Idle head turns to ~15 deg, as the previous candidate)
flat roughness; material contrast below the Medusa quality reference
UV atlas fill 49 % (1.27k islands from Tripo's charts): a dedicated packer would raise texel density by ~20 %
